blocks.text: Real-world analogue: A grand railway terminal after service decline, an airport concourse with most gates closed, a modernist white museum, and an immaculate transit hub whose signage is clearer than its remaining destinations.
World relation: A damaged overlap of Pilgrim and Open World functions. Travel and translation remain technically legible after meaningful difference has been standardized away.
Connection to newer locations: It relates to the Urban Canyon Hive, Underway of Returning Signals, Stair of Thin Air, Plain of Missing Distance, and City of Rainward Roofs.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: Perfect clarity can conceal semantic loss. A station can tell everyone exactly how to travel while offering fewer places worth arriving as oneself.
